scorer: operator adjudication of scorers A and B
method: Scorer A verdicts where both scorers agreed on every field; three disputed images resolved by the operator viewing the full image and detail crops before unblinding.

scores.notes: Pastel throne room: lion-headed, ox, man-faced and eagle-headed winged creatures with eyes on their wings flank an empty throne veiled in pink cloud under a green rainbow, on a reflective glass-tile floor. Throne holds only light and cloud, no form; painting reaches all four borders; no John, elders or lettering.

A: Only one seraph hovers top-center and its face and feet are uncovered (wings spread, not veiling), and it already holds tongs with a burning coal, which belongs to the later verse 6 moment; Isaiah is seen from the front-left holding a staff rather than from behind. The divine presence is only warm cloud-light in the upper hall, no figure; painting reaches all four edges and no lettering found in corners. | B: Single golden six-winged seraph hovers upper-center with wings veiling its face and holding tongs with a live coal; Isaiah stands lower-left facing the viewer in a carved cedar hall with incense and a smoking altar at right; the presence is only pink-gold light and cloud above. Only one seraph where the scene asks for several and the viewpoint is frontal rather than from behind Isaiah; painting reaches all four edges, no lettering found in any corner.
scores.adjudication: Operator viewed the image: one seraph with wings spread and face and feet uncovered, already holding tongs with a coal (verse 6), so the picture collages a later moment and contradicts the verse; coherence no as scorer A found.

scores.notes: Flat-color cartoon valley: David center-left with spent sling and shoulder bag, Goliath toppling sideways-forward in dust at lower right with spear and sword, Philistine ranks left and right, Israelite line on the far slope, walled city with towers upper right. Painted to all four edges; no lettering or corner marks found.

Three kneeling soldiers cast lots over a tunic and cloak on the rock in the foreground, but Jesus on the cross (upper right) is still fully dressed in a blue robe and white tunic, so the garments being divided are also still on him; he is also brightly lit rather than kept in restrained shadow. Jerusalem walls, dark sky and distant onlookers match; no lettering, painting reaches all edges.

A: Charcoal/ink drawing: Goliath in scale armour collapses on hands and knees centre-left in dust, David right-centre with arm extended, Philistine shield-wall left, Israelite line right, Gath on the hill top-right. The slung stone is still sitting in the pouch of David's sling (centre, above Goliath's back) while Goliath is already falling, an object-state contradiction with the verse. Drawing reaches all edges; no lettering. | B: Charcoal drawing: Goliath is already collapsing to hands and knees at center while the stone is still visibly seated in the pouch of David's outstretched sling (center-right), so the moment contradicts itself; he also falls to his hands rather than face-first. Philistine ranks left, Israelites right, Gath walls upper right; drawing reaches all edges, no lettering found.
scores.adjudication: Operator viewed the image: the stone still sits in the sling pouch while Goliath already collapses on hands and knees rather than face down; both scorers found it incoherent, and the requested instant is only partly shown.

scores.notes: Daniel at left looks up at three burning wheeled objects in the center that read more as flaming carts or wagons than as thrones with seats; white-robed assembly in ranks at both sides, shaft of white light from the top edge with no form in it. Painted to all edges, no signature or glyphs found.

Charcoal drawing: Jesus at left with right arm raised toward the dark empty tomb mouth, rolled stone beside it, Martha kneeling in brown with clasped hands at center-right, crowd of mourners in an arc behind; Lazarus not shown. The pale sky at top is toned drawing surface with hills drawn into it, not a blank band; drawing reaches all edges, no lettering.

Charcoal flock lying in grass beside a still pool with stone enclosure, village and hills behind, and a staff and sling propped on a rock at center right; scene matches. A signature-like scribble of glyphs (reads roughly 'JW.OSs.L') sits in the bottom-right corner on the grass, which counts as text.

Daniel at lower left in blue-fringed mantle with a scroll case looks up at four fiery thrones set in cloud at centre, white rays from the top edge, white-robed assembly in ranks left and right, Babylon skyline along the bottom. The Ancient of Days is shown only as the light from above, no figure; edges full; scroll case and robes carry no lettering.

A brown painted signature-like scribble sits in the bottom-right corner on the rocks beside the bush. Goliath falls backward onto his back with feet in the air rather than face-first; David, sling, bag, both armies and the walled city on the hill are present. Painted to all edges.

Pastel: white-bearded Moses foreground-left on wet sand holding a crook staff aloft, two tall green walls of water either side of a dry path receding to a bright cloud-break at center, Israelites with bundles and staves lined along the right bank. God appears only as light through storm cloud; no Egyptians; pigment reaches every edge, no writing.

Sheep lie in green grass before a still pool with a round stone sheepfold and walled village on the rise; a crook, sling pouch and folded cloak lean on a rock at lower left. No people, no lettering, paint reaches all four edges.

Older bearded man in undyed tunic sits on a stone bench at left, a blank partly-unrolled scroll on a low wooden table before him, three unnamed listeners (older woman, young woman, young man) seated on mats at right, open doorway to a sunlit Bethlehem landscape behind. No infant; scroll surface is blank; painting reaches every edge.

Pencil and wash drawing with Jesus center raising his arm toward the dark empty tomb at right, the rolled stone beside it, Martha kneeling with clasped hands at lower-left-center and a crowd of mourners behind; a second unnamed woman stands near the stone. Drawing reaches all four borders on toned paper, no lettering or corner marks.

Oil painting at dusk: Jesus in blue mantle left-center with raised arm facing the dark tomb opening, Martha kneeling in red at center-right, large crowd in an arc behind on the hillside. A scrawled painted signature (initial-like glyphs) sits in the bottom-right corner on the rocks, about 60px from the right edge; otherwise paint reaches all edges.

Sepia charcoal street with a cord-tied, weathered scroll on a stone wall in the foreground, oil lamp and papyrus sheets beside it, cloaks hanging on a doorpost at left, synagogue-like ashlar building and hills behind. Scroll and sheets are blank; drawing reaches all edges with no corner marks.

Four eyed-winged creatures (lion, red ox, man-faced, eagle-headed) around an empty radiant throne under a rainbow on a glass floor; throne holds only light. A cursive painted signature sits in the bottom-right corner on the floor reflection. The man-faced creature's head is rendered as a flat photographic face pasted on the body, giving a collage look.

Moses at foreground-left holds his staff upright with the sea parted into two tall walls and the dry floor receding to the center; the Israelites are small figures already walking through the gap rather than gathered on the bank, and a pillar of pink-grey cloud rises in the night sky with no figure in it. Painted to all edges, no text.

Charcoal seascape: brilliant light breaking through cloud upper-right over dark choppy water, deep black void upper-left, no figure or face in the light. A jagged dark stroke at right-center on the horizon reads as a distant shoreline, not lettering; charcoal reaches every edge with no white paper band.

Golden light breaks through dark clouds at upper left over dark rolling water, with low shore silhouettes at both sides; no figure or shape within the light. Painted strokes reach every edge, no lettering.

Grey-haired father in brown mantle embraces the ragged, barefoot son centre on a dusty road, dropped staff at lower left, farmhand at the courtyard gate at right, stone farmhouse and terraced Galilean hills behind. A cursive artist signature is painted in the bottom-right corner of the road; otherwise the scene matches.

Four winged creatures (lion, ox, human-faced, eagle) with eyes on their wings flank an empty throne at center, which is veiled only in a soft cloud of light with no figure; a golden chest stands before the steps and the reflective glass-like floor fills the foreground. Colored-pencil work reaches all edges, no lettering.

Pastel landscape: flock of sheep lying and grazing on green grass in the foreground, still pool at left-midground reflecting the sunset sky, staff and coiled sling laid on a rock lower-left, walled village with hearth smoke on the rise at right, hills behind. No people, no writing, pigment to all four edges.

Grey-haired father in brown robe, cloak flying, embraces and kisses the ragged barefoot son at center on a dusty road; dropped staff in the dust at lower left, stone farmhouse with two small household figures at the courtyard wall, terraced hills behind. No lettering, paint reaches all edges.

Father kisses the barefoot son's temple in a tight embrace centre on a stony road, staff dropped in the foreground, farmhand at the wall right, white village houses and a columned building on the hills behind. Painting reaches all four edges; no lettering or signature found in any corner.

Flat-color illustration: Jesus center with mouth open and arm raised toward the dark empty tomb at left, stone rolled aside, Martha kneeling with clasped hands in front of the stone, crowd of mourners in an arc at right, village on the hill behind. Painted to all four edges, no signature or marks in corners.

Oil: David seen from behind at center still whirling a sling overhead with a stone visibly loaded in the pouch, while Goliath at right is already pitching face-first into the dust and a second stone with motion streaks flies beside his chest; stone in sling, stone in flight and giant already struck are contradictory moments collaged together. Philistine helmets crowd both lower corners, Gath at left, armies on the far hill; a blue banner upper-right carries no lettering; paint to all edges.

Tinted drawing of the father embracing the barefoot ragged son at center on a stony road, robe streaming behind him, staff dropped at lower left, a single small figure at a doorway on the far left, terraced hills and stone houses. Drawing reaches all edges, no lettering or corner marks.

Weathered rolled scroll tied with cord lies on a sunlit stone wall in the foreground, clay oil lamp and a stack of blank papyrus sheets beside it, two undyed cloaks hanging on the doorpost at right, stone village street receding to a dry hillside. Scroll and sheets show only texture, no writing; edges full; no people.

Charcoal drawing with Daniel seen from behind at left looking at five wheeled thrones set in rolling fire and smoke across the center, white-robed assembly in rows on both sides, Babylonian rooftops behind, and rays of light pouring from the top edge with nothing formed inside them. Drawn to all borders, no lettering.

Charcoal on toned paper: five Roman soldiers kneeling in a ring, the center one letting lots fall from his hands, folded garments on the stones below, the cross with the crucified figure rising behind at upper-center under a dark sky, Jerusalem walls left, small onlookers at both edges. The title board above the crossbeam is blank wood with no letters; drawing fills all edges.

Charcoal street with a two-roller scroll partly unrolled on the foreground wall, cord dangling, oil lamp and papyrus stack at left, cloaks on a doorpost, synagogue building and hillside beyond; the scroll's exposed panel shows only hatching, no glyphs. Drawing reaches all edges.

Charcoal night scene: Moses on the near shore at left with staff raised over towering walls of water either side of a wet, track-marked seabed, Israelites small on the far side centre-right, a bright pillar of cloud and fire across the dark sky, town on the cliff top right. God appears only as the fire-cloud; drawing fills all edges; no lettering.

A cursive artist-style signature is written in the bottom-right corner in the grass below the sheep. Otherwise the charcoal landscape matches: flock lying in grass, still pool mid-ground, stone village walls on the right rise, crook and sling propped on the rock at right. Drawn to all edges.

Soft cartoon interior: grey-haired man in undyed tunic seated on a stone bench at left listening, a boy at a low table with a partly unrolled blank scroll, two women seated at right, open doorway with sunlit hills behind, jars and basket at the walls; no infant. Scroll shows no writing; painted to all four edges.

Lion, ox, man-faced and eagle creatures with eye-covered wings stand two on each side of an empty throne at center, which holds only a green-tinted cloud of light; floor is a reflective glass-like sea. No letters, paint reaches all edges. Cartoon style but the requested scene is depicted.

Cartoon style: grey-haired Isaiah with staff at centre looks up at a single six-winged seraph top-centre whose face and feet are uncovered and who already carries tongs with a glowing coal (the later verse-6 moment); several childlike unnamed onlookers stand along the bottom left and right of the gilded hall. Presence shown only as light and cloud; edges full; wall reliefs show winged figures but no lettering.

Charcoal courtyard interior: an older bearded man in a plain tunic seated on a stone bench at left-center, two rolled scrolls on a low table in front with no writing visible, a young man and woman seated on a mat at right, open doorway with pale light and hills behind; no infant. Drawing reaches all four borders, no lettering or marks.

Oil: four helmeted soldiers crouch over lots and spread garments on the rocky hilltop, Jerusalem with a dome and tower behind right. Jesus at top-center stands upright, fully clothed in white tunic and grey mantle, head bowed, with the cross merely behind his shoulders; he is not crucified while his clothes are being divided below, which contradicts the moment. No lettering; paint reaches all edges.

Watercolor street with a scroll partly unrolled across the foreground wall, lamp and sheets at right, cloaks on a doorpost at left, columned synagogue facade and dry hillside behind; unrolled panel and sheets are blank. Paint reaches all edges, no corner marks.

Jesus in white tunic and grey mantle stands centre with right arm raised toward the open rock-cut tomb at right, its rolled stone beside the black doorway which shows no figure inside; a woman kneels with clasped hands at centre-left, a crowd of mourners in Judean dress arcs behind at left, two figures stand near the tomb at right, warm dusk light. Edges full; no lettering.

Pencil sketch on toned paper: David at left with arm extended and sling loose, Goliath tumbling backward head-down with legs in the air at center-right rather than falling face-first, Philistines at right, Israelite ranks on the left slope, walled city behind. Drawn to all edges including the pale sky; no signature or glyphs in any corner.

A: Pastel seascape: warm peach light breaking through cloud upper-left over dark teal water, mist bands and a faint low headland at right, darkness filling the right and lower frame; no figure or shape in the light. Zoomed left edge shows pigment (teal, pink, grey) running to the border rather than bare paper; no writing anywhere. | B: Pastel: warm pink-gold light breaking through cloud at upper left over dark teal water, with a low dark shoreline ridge at right and no figure in the light. At the top-left corner a grainy olive-grey band roughly 20-40 px wide runs along the left and top edges where the toned paper shows through with little pigment; it is a soft pastel fringe rather than a hard border, so whether it counts as unpainted paper is a judgment call. No lettering anywhere.
scores.adjudication: Operator viewed the top-left corner at 3x: a khaki band of toned ground with little pigment runs along the left and top edges. The rule treats a blank band at a border as a margin, and candidates have no soft-edge allowance, so it is recorded as a margin and the image as flawed. A judgment call, as scorer B noted.

scores.notes: Isaiah with staff at left looks up at a single bronze six-winged seraph hovering above a smoking altar; its face is veiled but its feet are bare, and it carries tongs with a glowing coal (the verse 6 moment) while the verse calls for several seraphim veiling face and feet. The presence is only light and haze; carved winged figures on the frieze are decoration. Drawing reaches all edges, no lettering.
